UnitStatement: Fixture MECH-TP-PHYS-007 uses a two-node straight pipe aligned to global X.
TP-PHYS-007 fixture inputs: L=4.0 m, E=1000.0 Pa, G=400.0 Pa, A=3.0 m^2, I_y=1.5, I_z=2.0, J=1.0 m^4, uniform Y load q=-2.0 N/m over a/L=0.25 to b/L=0.75.
TP-PHYS-007 requested station fractions are 0.75, 0.25, 0.5, 1.0, intentionally unsorted; node 0 fixed and node 1 free.
The TP-PHYS-007 equivalent nodal loads and fixed-free solve reuse the public case MECH-TP-PHYS-006-PARTIAL-SPAN-LOAD-TO-RESULTANT.
For load over 0.25<=x/L<=0.75 the equivalent nodal loads are F_y,i=-2.0, M_z,i=-11/6, F_y,j=-2.0, M_z,j=11/6.
With node 0 fixed, the solved node 1 displacement path is u_y,1=-7/500 and theta_z,1=-13/3000.
Loaded I-end resultants recovered from K u - f_equivalent are V_y,i=4.0 and M_z,i=8.0.
Repository straight-pipe signed-resultant recurrence: V_y(x)=V_y,i + q*active_length; M_z(x)=M_z,i - V_y,i*x - q*lever_integral.
For TP-PHYS-007 the active loaded interval uses s0=1.0, s1=3.0, active_end=min(x,s1), active_length=max(0,active_end-active_start).
TP-PHYS-007 expected station outputs (requested order): x=3.0 gives V_y=0,M_z=0; x=1.0 gives V_y=4.0,M_z=4.0; x=2.0 gives V_y=2.0,M_z=1.0; x=4.0 gives V_y=0,M_z=0.
At station 0.75 the full loaded span is accumulated so internal shear and bending return to free-side zero; at 1.0 no further load exists so resultants remain zero.
